pins.title: Apartment or Garage? Sauna Blanket vs Cold Plunge by the Space You Have
pins.subtitle: Fill-and-drain tub or fold-away blanket
pins.description: A collapsible cold plunge tub needs a flat, water-safe spot like a garage floor or patio, plus room to fill and drain. A sauna blanket needs a bed or floor to lie on and a nearby outlet, then folds into a closet. No outdoor access? The blanket is usually the more space-realistic pick. Heart condition, pregnant, or circulation issues? Check with a doctor first. Not medical advice. #coldplunge #saunablanket #apartmentliving #homerecovery

pins.title: Contrast Therapy at Home: Start With One Tool, Add the Second Later
pins.subtitle: Cold plunge or sauna blanket first
pins.description: You don't need a full contrast therapy setup on day one. Pick the tool that matches your main need, use it consistently for a few months, then reassess: training hard may point to a cold plunge first, stress and wind-down to a sauna blanket. Alternating heat and cold isn't something to combine casually, so talk to a healthcare provider first. Not medical advice. #contrasttherapy #coldplunge #saunablanket #recoveryroutine
